status: experimental / future work (proposal Section 15); outputs derive from a SIMULATED pilot
save_probability: sigmoid(a + 0.6*price_gap - kappa*z_risk), clipped [0.01, 0.80]; a solved so mean = 0.22
uplift_sign_convention: uplift = reduction in churn probability if contacted (positive = offer helps)
learner_selection_rule: one-standard-error rule on mean Qini AUC across 20 simulated pilots: simplest learner within 1 paired SE of the best; complexity order = ['X-learner (Ridge stage 2)', 'X-learner (XGBoost)', 'T-learner (XGBoost)']
